from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """An expense figure reported in one company's financial statement for the period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Total Operating Expenses', 'Administration expense')")
    expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount as reported in the filing")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the figure covers")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expenses: list[CompanyExpense]
